DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 compatibility update, signed reasoning stream support, and client navigation fix.

Support official DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` while retaining `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2` compatibility (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 || 0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.5`).

Treat the leading reasoning signature envelope in raw reasoning frames as metadata so it cannot hide the first prose opening, trigger a false discard, pollute the preview, or inflate prose timing, while preserving raw JSONL stream persistence.

Fix client session navigation by declaring the workspace UI dependency and using `uiWorkspace.openSession` instead of the nonexistent `sessions.open`. This resolves a pre-existing issue from 1.7.0 where client activation failed on all supported official runtimes.

支持官方 DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`（同时保留对 `0.2.0-rc.2` 和 `0.2.1-rc.2` 的兼容，声明范围为 `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 || 0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.5`）。

将流式思维链首部的签名信封（signature envelope）视为元数据剥离，防止遮挡首段散文开头、导致误判中止、污染实时预览或引起计时漂移，同时在宿主 JSONL 中完整保留原始流式数据。

修复客户端会话导航：声明工作区 UI 依赖并使用 `uiWorkspace.openSession` 替代不存在的 `sessions.open`。该问题在已发布的 1.7.0 中即存在并导致所有官方运行时上客户端启动失败，本次修复使各版本均能正常激活并打开会话。

Declared DSH range: `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 || 0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.5`. Keep the previous plugin version on older DSH. See [Validation record](.github/reviews/dsh-0.2.1-rc.5.md).

Validation: automated regression suite (`npm test`, 27 test files), client bundle verification (`npm run check:client`), npm package check (`npm run check:package`, 11 runtime files), publication workflow tests (10/10 checks), fresh-boot and restart acceptance across all three official runtimes (`0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.5`), and isolated headless Edge browser verification against official rc.5 Web runtime.

Install from npm or the attached archive:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-plugin-rollout-scout-1.8.0.tgz
```

Restart DSH after updating.
